method.walkForward: Each test year scored by models fitted only on rows scored at least a year before it starts
method.label: An Item 1.03 (bankruptcy or receivership) 8-K within 365 days after the scoring date
method.scoringDate: The day after each 10-K or 10-Q was filed; only figures filed before that day are used
method.alert: Score above which 5% of non-bankrupt rows fell in earlier out-of-sample years
